title: Manoj Bajpayee reacts to Tiger Shroff firing incident, says “That's really scary”
raw_summary:
Veteran actor Manoj Bajpayee has expressed concern over the firing incident targeting Tiger Shroff’s car in Mumbai’s Juhu neighbourhood, describing the situation as frightening and emphasising the need for a thorough investigation. Speaking to news agency ANI, Bajpayee said he was relieved that the Baaghi actor had escaped unharmed and hoped the authorities would take decisive action.

Reacting to the incident, Bajpayee said, “I don't see a gang war, but shots are being fired from who knows where, and that's really scary. Secondly, it's sad what happened to Tiger, but the best and happiest part is that he's safe, and his driver is also recovering slowly. Anyway, we aren't law and order experts or anything. From what I've heard in the news, the investigation is ongoing. The alleged suspects have been brought to Mumbai, and they've been arrested. I just hope the investigation wraps up as soon as possible and that an example is set so that next time, anyone will think twice before doing something like this.”

The incident took place on the evening of Sunday, October 18, when unidentified assailants allegedly opened fire at Tiger Shroff’s car in Juhu before fleeing on a motorcycle. The actor escaped without gunshot injuries, while his driver, Firdous, and a bystander sustained injuries and were taken to Nanavati Hospital for treatment. The driver is reportedly recovering.

The Mumbai Crime Branch’s Anti-Extortion Cell is leading the investigation. According to reports, the suspected shooters fled Mumbai through Gujarat and Rajasthan and were intercepted in Kota before being brought back to the city. On October 21, a court remanded three accused to police custody until October 31 as investigators continued questioning them.

The probe has also widened beyond the alleged shooters. The Delhi Police Special Cell has reportedly arrested individuals suspected of being part of an interstate weapons supply network linked to the case. Investigators are examining possible connections to an overseas-based syndicate allegedly affiliated with the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. An online claim of responsibility has also been reported, although the alleged links and motive remain subject to investigation.

Meanwhile, reports that the accused may have conducted reconnaissance near other prominent residences have prompted precautionary security measures, including heightened security around Salman Khan’s Galaxy Apartments in Bandra.

Tiger Shroff’s team has urged the public and media to avoid speculation while the investigation continues. The authorities are expected to establish the circumstances surrounding the attack and determine whether a wider conspiracy was involved.

Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi, Rakul Preet Singh, Ravie Dubey, producer Namit Malhotra, director Nitesh Tiwari and music maestro A R Rahman attended the musical event for their film Ramayana in Chennai. At this event, Ranbir Kapoor mistakenly said, “Burai chahe kitne bhi taaqatwar kyun na ho, aakhir mein anth sacchai aur acchaai ki hi hogi”. The video went viral on social media, leading to a lot of trolling.

Ranbir Kapoor began by saying, “Vanakkam, Chennai! Thank you for this love and energy. We really feel welcomed by all you beautiful people. Ramayana is a story that connects all of us through love, faith and our culture. I have had the privilege of working with the maestro, Mr Rahman, on two of my films (Rockstar and Tamasha). And both have been really special to me. But sir, this opportunity will be remembered forever. It’s really an opportunity of a lifetime to collaborate with you on this film.”

He then said, “I would like to take this opportunity to apologize for an incident that happened yesterday. I was at a Dussehra event and I had a slip of tongue. title: Viraj Ghelani and Arjun Tanwar starrer Party Animals trailer out ahead of November 20 release
raw_summary:
Yoodlee Films has released the trailer of its upcoming comedy Party Animals, starring Viraj Ghelani and Arjun Tanwar. Blending absurd humour, internet culture and a series of increasingly chaotic situations, the film promises a comedy driven by friendship, impulsive decisions and a night that spirals out of control. Directed by Ravi Chhabriya, the film is scheduled to release in cinemas on November 20, 2026.

Set on New Year’s Eve, the trailer follows a group of friends whose reunion quickly turns into an unpredictable series of events. Featuring cops, goons, a party bus, romantic complications, petty fights and even a drunk horse, the film builds its comedy around a string of mishaps. Every attempt by the characters to resolve one problem only leads to another, setting the stage for a night filled with confusion and questionable decisions.

The trailer has also generated conversations online, with viewers reacting to its unconventional humour and chaotic storytelling. One user quipped, “This looks like the group chat got a production budget,” while another exclaimed, “I don’t know what I just watched, but I need the full story immediately.” Drawing from internet culture, Party Animals appears to embrace the absurdity of its situations, using the characters’ misadventures as the basis for its comedy.

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by Yoodlee Films (@yoodleefilms)

Beyond the humour, the film explores contemporary friendships, the fear of missing out (FOMO), the confusion of growing up and the confidence with which a seemingly bad idea can turn into an elaborate plan late at night. Bringing the format of Hollywood ensemble comedies into an Indian setting, the film centres on one night that takes increasingly unexpected turns.

Speaking about the film, Viraj Ghelani says, “Party Animals is the kind of madness that’s hard to explain but a whole lot of fun to experience, especially with your gang of friends. From the music and the madness to the moments of pure unfiltered masti, the film celebrates that crazy energy, unbreakable bhaichara and collective bad decisions that make for the best stories. I had a blast being part of this chaos, and I can’t wait for audiences to experience it together on the big screen.”

Siddharth Anand Kumar, Senior Vice President, Saregama India Ltd., adds, “With Party Animals, we wanted to create a comedy that embraces its own madness and doesn’t take itself too seriously. It’s bold, irreverent and best enjoyed with your gang, where every terrible decision becomes a story worth telling.”

Directed by Ravi Chhabriya and produced by Vikram Mehra and Siddharth Anand Kumar under the banner of Yoodlee Films, Party Animals features Viraj Ghelani as Mann Patel and Arjun Tanwar as Armaan Khanna. The ensemble cast also includes Pragati Nagpal, Naqiyah Haji, Alam Khan, Saqib Ayub, Kamlesh Sawant, Anil Charanjeett, Aaron Koul, Vijay Patkar and Manoj Joshi. The film is written by Ali Haji, Khush Mullick and Veer Panchal.

With its focus on friendship, impulsive choices and escalating chaos, Party Animals brings a group of friends together for a night that promises to be anything but predictable. The film releases in cinemas on November 20, 2026.

Additional police personnel have been deployed around the Bandra residence, with heightened patrolling reported in the area after investigators reportedly learnt that Salman may have been the original target of the alleged plot.

The development comes days after three motorcycle-borne assailants opened fire at Tiger Shroff’s car in Mumbai’s Juhu area on October 18. Tiger escaped unharmed, while his driver and a passerby were injured in the incident. Seven rounds were reportedly fired at the actor’s vehicle.

title: The biggest competitor for King is not another superstar or another film. It is Shah Rukh Khan's own box-office history
raw_summary:
The year 2023 was nothing short of historic for Shah Rukh Khan. After a four-year hiatus from leading roles, the superstar returned with Pathaan, which collected Rs. 1,050.30 crores worldwide, followed by Jawan, which went a step further with a staggering Rs. 1,148.32 crores. Together, the two films amassed nearly Rs. 2,200 crores globally, reaffirming his position as one of Indian cinema's biggest superstars. Three years later, Shah Rukh Khan is gearing up for his next theatrical release, King, directed by Siddharth Anand and scheduled to hit cinemas on December 24, 2026.

The excitement surrounding King is understandable. The film reunites Shah Rukh Khan with his Pathaan director, promises high-octane action and features an ensemble cast including Deepika Padukone, Suhana Khan and Abhishek Bachchan. However, beneath all the anticipation lies an interesting question: Has Shah Rukh Khan raised the bar so extraordinarily high that even a hugely successful film might now be considered a disappointment?

Before Pathaan and Jawan, a worldwide collection of Rs. 300-400 crores was considered an impressive achievement for many Bollywood films. But Shah Rukh Khan changed the conversation by delivering two consecutive Rs. 1,000 crore blockbusters, and in doing so, possibly created an unusually high benchmark for himself.

Today, the discussion around King isn't merely about whether it will succeed. Fans and trade observers are already speculating about whether it can cross Rs. 1,000 crores, surpass Pathaan or even challenge Jawan. Imagine a scenario where King collects Rs. 600-700 crores worldwide. Such numbers would be extraordinary for most Hindi films, yet there is a possibility that sections of the industry and social media would term the performance underwhelming simply because Shah Rukh Khan has delivered bigger hits in the past.

Ironically, King may find its biggest competition not in another film or superstar, but in Shah Rukh Khan's own box-office records.

Adding to the expectations is the film's reported scale. In July, Bollywood Hungama reported that King was being mounted on a production budget of approximately Rs. 450 crores, excluding publicity expenses and Shah Rukh Khan's remuneration. Siddharth Anand subsequently disputed the circulating budget reports, and hence, the actual cost remains unconfirmed. Nevertheless, the film is being positioned as an ambitious action spectacle, and its commercial performance will naturally attract considerable attention.

Its December 24 release also comes with challenges. The Christmas and New Year holidays provide an excellent opportunity for a huge opening, but December 2026 is packed with major releases, including Hollywood spectacles like Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three. Competition for screens and premium formats could affect King, particularly if the film hopes to enjoy the kind of extended theatrical run that helped Pathaan and Jawan achieve their historic numbers.

Shah Rukh Khan's prolonged absence from cinemas could work in his favour, as audiences haven't seen him in a leading theatrical role since Dunki (2023). However, there is an important difference between his return with Pathaan and his upcoming release.

Pathaan marked his comeback after a difficult phase at the box office, and audiences were eager to see whether he could reclaim his position. With King, there is no such question about his stardom. Instead, audiences are expecting another spectacular entertainer, complete with memorable dialogues, breathtaking action and larger-than-life moments.

The reunion with Siddharth Anand adds to these expectations. Having delivered a historic blockbuster together, the two will inevitably face comparisons with Pathaan. The challenge for King will be to offer something fresh rather than merely recreate the formula that worked so brilliantly in 2023.

The film also marks Shah Rukh Khan's much-anticipated big-screen collaboration with his daughter Suhana Khan, which will generate additional curiosity. However, for the film to succeed beyond the initial excitement, its story, performances and emotional appeal will have to connect with audiences.

If King earns Rs. 700 crores worldwide instead of Rs. 1,000 crores, it wouldn't automatically make the film a failure. Its actual profitability would depend on production costs, distribution arrangements, marketing expenditure and revenues from digital, satellite and music rights. A film can deliver impressive gross collections without necessarily generating equally impressive returns, while a relatively smaller grosser can be highly profitable if its costs are controlled.

The irony is that Pathaan and Jawan, the very films that re-established Shah Rukh Khan's box-office dominance, could now become the benchmarks against which every subsequent release is measured. If King delivers another Rs. 1,000 crore blockbuster, it will further cement his extraordinary legacy. But if it earns substantially less while still emerging as a major commercial success, should it really be viewed as a disappointment?

After all, no actor, irrespective of his superstardom, can be expected to deliver an all-time blockbuster with every release.

Perhaps the biggest danger surrounding King isn't that Shah Rukh Khan might fail to deliver another blockbuster. It's that Bollywood has reached a stage where even a blockbuster from Shah Rukh Khan may no longer be considered good enough.

title: EXCLUSIVE: CBFC censors shot of blood on the Indian map in Udta Teer
raw_summary:
The spy comedy, Udta Teer, will release on October 23, and has caught attention due to its quirky plot, funny moments and the casting. The makers completed the censor process in time and in this article, Bollywood Hungama will exclusively focus on the cuts given to the film.

Udta Teer was passed with a U/A 13+ certificate. However, the makers had to make just one major cut. The shot showing blood on the Indian map was asked to be removed. To cover up the cut, the CBFC asked the makers to extend the preceding shot.

Secondly, the makers were asked to add the anti-smoking disclaimer, 'Smoking Kills', in five scenes. An anti-liquor disclaimer was asked to be added in a scene of alcohol consumption. Thankfully, no changes were made in the dialogues or in action scenes.

Once these changes were made, Udta Teer was passed by the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC). The length of the film, as mentioned on the censor certificate, is 137.41 minutes. In other words, Udta Teer is 2 hours, 17 minutes and 41 seconds.

Udta Teer stars Ayushmann Khurrana, Sara Ali Khan, the late Mukul Dev and several others. Written and directed by Akash A Kaushik, the film is produced by Karan Johar, Adar Poonawalla and Apoorva Mehta's Dharma Productions, along with Guneet Monga Kapoor and Achin Jain's Sikhya Entertainment.

The film tells the story of a Pakistani spy who infiltrates India but ends up losing his memory. In an unexpected turn of events, he begins believing that he is a hardcore Indian patriot, leading to chaos and madness.

title: Were Salman Khan, Aamir Khan and Akshay Kumar on the target list? Police official CLARIFIES after Tiger Shroff firing incident
raw_summary:
A police official has clarified that the interrogation of four people arrested in connection with the firing incident targeting actor Tiger Shroff’s car has not revealed any information about another celebrity being targeted. The clarification comes amid reports claiming that Salman Khan was the original target and that the accused had also surveyed the residences of other Bollywood stars, including Aamir Khan and Akshay Kumar.

Speaking about the arrests, Praveen Tripathi, Deputy Commissioner of Police (Special Cell), said the four accused were allegedly involved in the weapon supply network linked to the case. He explained that their role was limited to procuring firearms, transporting them to Mumbai and delivering them to the intended recipients.

When asked whether any other celebrity had been targeted, Tripathi told ANI, “Nothing of that sort emerged during our interrogation, as these individuals were merely part of the weapon supply network. Their knowledge was limited strictly to where to procure the weapons and where to deliver them...”

His statement does not confirm that Aamir Khan, Akshay Kumar or Salman Khan were on the target list. It specifically addresses what investigators learnt from the four people questioned in connection with the alleged supply of weapons. What the reports claim about Salman Khan and other actors Reports citing investigation sources have claimed that Salman Khan was initially targeted, but the alleged plan was reconsidered after the accused conducted a recce of his Galaxy Apartments residence and found the security arrangements difficult to overcome. According to these reports, Tiger Shroff was subsequently identified as a comparatively easier target.

Other reports have also claimed that the accused moved around Mumbai posing as ordinary visitors and surveyed locations associated with several Bollywood celebrities, including Amitabh Bachchan, Aamir Khan and Akshay Kumar. These claims have been attributed to investigation sources and should not be treated as confirmed by Tripathi’s statement.

The police official’s remarks are significant because they distinguish the alleged role of the four arrested individuals from the wider investigation into the attack. His statement does not establish whether the alleged target list included other celebrities, nor does it independently confirm the reported reconnaissance at their residences. Four arrested over alleged weapon supply network According to Tripathi, a special team arrested four people: two women, Radha and Babita, and two men, Kunal and Sumit. He said Kunal, who had recently been released from jail in connection with another case, allegedly travelled to Amritsar with Sumit to collect weapons on the instructions of Anil Pandit.

Tripathi alleged that Kunal subsequently used Radha and Babita to transport the weapons to Mumbai. The women allegedly delivered them to a minor near a railway station. He added that Kunal was in contact with Pandit through encrypted communication and had previously carried out a shooting incident in Panipat at his behest.

The investigation into the October 18 firing incident involving Tiger Shroff’s car in Mumbai is ongoing.

title: Saif Ali Khan begins shooting for Ritesh Batra’s period drama in Mumbai; details of new collaboration remain under wraps
raw_summary:
Saif Ali Khan has reportedly commenced shooting for an upcoming period drama directed by internationally acclaimed filmmaker Ritesh Batra in Mumbai. The collaboration brings together an actor known for his diverse choice of roles and a director whose work has earned recognition across international cinema. While details about the project remain under wraps, the pairing has generated curiosity given their respective filmographies and approaches to storytelling.

Ritesh Batra rose to international prominence with his 2013 directorial debut, The Lunchbox, starring Irrfan Khan, Nimrat Kaur and Nawazuddin Siddiqui. The film, which explored an unexpected emotional connection between two strangers in Mumbai, received widespread appreciation for its understated storytelling and performances. It also established Batra as a filmmaker capable of finding compelling human stories in everyday situations.

Following the success of The Lunchbox, Batra ventured into international cinema with projects including The Sense of an Ending and Netflix’s Our Souls at Night, which featured Robert Redford and Jane Fonda. His work across different cinematic landscapes has earned him a reputation for character-driven narratives and nuanced explorations of human relationships.

For Saif Ali Khan, the project marks another addition to a career characterised by a willingness to experiment with different genres and characters. The actor has frequently moved beyond conventional mainstream roles, exploring morally complex characters and unconventional narratives across theatrical and streaming projects.

His performance in Netflix’s Sacred Games demonstrated his ability to navigate the darker shades of a crime drama, while films such as Homi Adajania’s Being Cyrus and Navdeep Singh’s period revenge drama Laal Kaptaan showcased his interest in distinctive storytelling. The upcoming collaboration with Batra could offer another opportunity for the actor to explore a different cinematic space.

title: Sony LIV joins Prime Video India as an add-on subscription; plans start at Rs 399 per month
raw_summary:
Prime Video India has added Sony LIV to its list of add-on subscriptions, allowing customers to access the streaming platform’s movies, original series, television shows and live sports through a single service. Announced on October 21, the partnership gives viewers another option to access Sony LIV’s content without switching between separate apps.

Sony LIV will be available to Prime Video customers through two subscription plans priced at Rs 399 per month and Rs 1,499 per year. The service can be accessed through mobile devices, web browsers, Fire TV, smart TVs and other compatible living room devices.

The partnership brings Sony LIV’s library of more than 450 movies and 300 shows to Prime Video’s entertainment offering, alongside its live sports coverage and multilingual programming. What can viewers watch through Sony LIV on Prime Video? Sony LIV’s catalogue includes original series such as the Scam franchise and Gullak, along with films such as Sitaare Zameen Par. The service also offers popular television programmes from Sony Entertainment Television and Sony SAB, including Kaun Banega Crorepati, Indian Idol, Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah and Pushpa Impossible.

Reality and entertainment programming available through the platform includes KBC Season 18, Indian Idol Season 17 and Family Full House With Rohit Sharma.

Sports coverage is another key part of the partnership. Sony LIV offers live coverage of bilateral India cricket, the UEFA Champions League, the French Open, the Commonwealth Games and UFC, among other sporting events.

The announcement also highlighted India's upcoming tour of New Zealand, featuring Test matches, One Day Internationals and T20 Internationals, beginning October 22.

With content available in Hindi, English, Marathi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam and Gujarati, the partnership further expands the range of regional and international entertainment accessible through Prime Video. Prime Video and Sony LIV on the partnership Commenting on the development, Gaurav Bhasin, Head of AVOD Business and Marketplace at Prime Video India, said the addition would give customers access to a wider selection of entertainment and sports content.

“Our ambition has always been to make Prime Video the ultimate entertainment destination for our customers. With Sony LIV now available as an add-on subscription, we take a significant step forward in that journey,” Bhasin said.

He added that the partnership combines television programming and live sports with Prime Video’s existing catalogue.

“Along with our extensive library, customers now have the daily viewing cadence of television and a near-continuous calendar of live sports, from bilateral India cricket to the UEFA Champions League, all on one service. This deepens the breadth and choice of multilingual entertainment we offer, and we are excited about what it means for the millions of entertainment and sports fans across India,” he added.

Rajesh Kaul, Chief Revenue Officer and Business Head, Sports and International at Sony Pictures Networks India, said the partnership would help Sony LIV reach audiences through another platform.

“At Sony LIV, we’re always looking for new ways to make our content available to audiences wherever they choose to watch it. Our partnership with Prime Video is an important step in expanding that reach in India. It gives viewers another convenient way to discover and access Sony LIV's diverse content offering,” Kaul said.

He also highlighted the platform’s television programming, regional content, live sports and original series as important parts of its offering.

“Live sports and our slate of acclaimed Originals remain key to our proposition. Through this association, we look forward to taking the breadth of Sony LIV's entertainment and sports offering to more viewers across India and the world,” he added. How Prime Video add-on subscriptions work The addition of Sony LIV expands Prime Video’s selection of third-party subscriptions. The service allows customers to browse content from participating streaming platforms in one place rather than managing each service separately.

According to Prime Video, add-on subscriptions also offer consolidated billing, a shared watchlist, a download library for offline viewing and personalised recommendations. Customers can manage their subscriptions through Prime Video, although individual content catalogues and subscription terms may vary by provider.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Gulshan Devaiah DEBUNKS Wikipedia's claim that he made his debut in Salman Khan's Dil Ne Jise Apna Kahaa: “Even I have seen it and I laugh at it!”
raw_summary:
Gulshan Devaiah's next film, Little Thomas, releases next Friday, October 23. In an exclusive interview with Bollywood Hungama, the talented actor spoke about what he does on the day of his film's release and also cleared up an interesting misconception about his filmography that's been circulating on the internet.

When asked whether he visits cinemas to gauge audience reactions or relies on social media to see how people are responding to his films and performances, Gulshan Devaiah made an honest confession. He said, “I don't even check social media. My job is done, and now it's up to the audience to decide. This is also a way of self-preservation for me so that I don't get stressed. It's human tendency – 100 people would have praised you, but that one negative comment will bother you (laughs). You forget that 100 people have said good things.”

He added, “It also depends on my mood. At times, I do actively check how the film is doing and look into its business aspects.”

Meanwhile, Wikipedia mentions that Gulshan Devaiah appeared in the 2004 Salman Khan-Preity Zinta-Bhumika Chawla starrer Dil Ne Jise Apna Kahaa. The website further claims that he played a DJ in the romantic drama. Interestingly, when we revisited the film, we spotted a DJ in the background of the song ‘Go Balle Balle’. A few shots even focused on the DJ, but he didn't appear to be Gulshan.

Hence, we decided to ask Gulshan Devaiah himself whether he had indeed appeared in Dil Ne Jise Apna Kahaa. The actor clarified, “That's not true. 2011 was my debut year. That Girl In Yellow Boots' festival screening happened in 2010. However, in 2002, I did an English film called Brides Wanted. I did it when I was in Bengaluru. However, it never got released.”

He continued, “Even I have seen the Dil Ne Jise Apna Kahaa mention on my Wikipedia page, and I laugh at it! Hopefully, in the future, Amitabh Bachchan will ask about my debut on KBC (Kaun Banega Crorepati), and both That Girl In Yellow Boots and Dil Ne Jise Apna Kahaa will be among the options (laughs).”

title: Tiger Shroff’s team issues statement after firing in Juhu, says actor made “no statements” about incident
raw_summary:
Tiger Shroff’s team has issued an official statement addressing the circulation of fake stories, AI-generated videos and unauthorised content attributed to the actor following the firing incident in Mumbai’s Juhu area. The team clarified that Shroff has not made any statement or released any video regarding the incident and urged people to rely only on verified communication.

The statement comes two days after the actor’s car was targeted in a firing incident near Pushpa Park in Juhu on October 18. Shroff was leaving the area after playing football when unidentified men on a motorcycle allegedly opened fire at his vehicle. The actor escaped unharmed, while his driver and another person were injured, according to police and media reports. Tiger Shroff’s team denies statements attributed to actor Addressing the misinformation circulating online, Team Tiger categorically denied that the actor had spoken publicly about the incident or authorised any communication.

The team said in its statement, “We would like to categorically clarify that Tiger Shroff has made no statements, released no videos, and authorised no communication regarding the recent incident or any related developments.”

It further alleged that several social media pages and digital platforms were sharing fabricated stories and AI-generated videos while presenting them as statements or reactions from the actor.

The statement read, “It has come to our attention that several social media pages and digital platforms are circulating fabricated stories, AI-generated videos and scripted narratives, falsely attributed to Tiger. These are completely false, unauthorised and intended to mislead the public.”

Team Tiger also made it clear that neither the actor nor his team had any association with such material.

“We do not endorse, support, or have any association with such content,” the statement said.

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by Bollywood Hungama🎥 (@realbollywoodhungama)

Team Tiger warns of legal action The actor’s team also called upon media organisations, digital platforms and social media pages to verify information before publishing or amplifying it.

“We urge media outlets, digital platforms and social media pages to exercise responsibility, verify information before publishing, and refrain from creating or amplifying misinformation for engagement or monetary gain,” the statement read.

The team further warned that those responsible for creating or circulating such content could face legal consequences.

“Any individual or page found creating, promoting or circulating such fabricated content will face appropriate legal action,” it stated, adding that the team was taking cognisance of the matter and reserved the right to pursue all available legal remedies.

The statement concluded with an appeal to the public to rely on official sources for updates concerning the actor.

“We request everyone to rely only on verified communication from Tiger Shroff and his official team,” Team Tiger said. Tiger Shroff firing incident under investigation The clarification comes as the investigation into the October 18 firing incident continues. Mumbai Police had confirmed that Shroff was safe and had not suffered any gunshot injury after unidentified people opened fire at his car near Pushpa Park. Police subsequently registered a case and launched a search for those responsible.

A social media claim attributed responsibility for the attack to individuals allegedly linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. However, initial reports noted that the authenticity of the claim and the alleged gang connection had not been independently verified by police.

title: Janhvi Kapoor to pay tribute to mother Sridevi at IIFA 2027
raw_summary:
Janhvi Kapoor could be set to create an emotional moment at the upcoming International Indian Film Academy (IIFA) Awards 2027 by paying tribute to her late mother, legendary actress Sridevi. IIFA co-founder Andre Timmins has revealed that the actress is expected to honour Sridevi through a special performance at the forthcoming ceremony, which will take place at the Etihad Arena on Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, on January 22 and 23.

Speaking to ANI, Andre Timmins shared details about the planned tribute and said that Janhvi was excited about the opportunity. He also revealed that her father, producer Boney Kapoor, was particularly enthusiastic about the performance. "Janhvi will pay tribute to her mother, Sridevi, who's a brilliant artist that we had on this planet. I think that's the only tribute right now, and she's excited about it and more than her, her father, Boney, is more excited about it, so I think it'll be exciting," he told the portal.

If confirmed as part of the final programme, the tribute would bring together Janhvi’s personal connection to Sridevi and the late actress’s enduring legacy in Indian cinema. Sridevi, one of Hindi cinema’s most celebrated performers, left behind a body of work spanning several languages and genres.

Meanwhile, Janhvi has also expressed her excitement about returning to IIFA, recalling the experience of her first performance at the awards ceremony in Abu Dhabi. In a statement, the actress spoke about the energy of performing before an international audience and the significance of the event in celebrating Indian cinema.

“My first IIFA performance in Abu Dhabi will always hold a very special place in my heart. I remember the excitement, the nerves and the incredible energy of that night, and to now return to the IIFA stage feels like coming back with so much more love and excitement. IIFA is such a beautiful celebration because it brings together artists, audiences and the global Indian community through something we all love, cinema. Performing at IIFA is an experience like no other. There is something incredibly special about seeing an audience from across the world come together and celebrate Indian music, films and performers with so much enthusiasm. Abu Dhabi gave me such a memorable first IIFA experience, and I am thrilled to return to Yas Island for another chapter. I cannot wait to dance, perform and hopefully create another moment that stays with the audience long after the lights go down,” she said.

On the work front, Janhvi Kapoor is next expected to feature in Lag Jaa Gale, co-starring Lakshya and Tiger Shroff. The actress also has an untitled project directed by Umesh Bisht, featuring Sreeleela alongside her, apart from other projects in the pipeline.

With the 27th edition of IIFA approaching, the possibility of Janhvi paying tribute to Sridevi has added an emotional dimension to the celebrations. Further details about the performance are awaited.

title: Ramayana: Part 1 tax-free in West Bengal: CM confirms exemption for Ranbir Kapoor starrer
raw_summary:
Ramayana: Part 1, directed by Nitesh Tiwari and headlined by Ranbir Kapoor, has received a significant boost ahead of its theatrical release, with West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari confirming that the mythological film will be made tax-free in the state. Speaking to ANI, the Chief Minister also referred to films such as The Kerala Story, The Kashmir Files and The Bengal Files while discussing the decision, and indicated that more mythological stories could make their way to the big screen in the coming years.

“The Ramayana film has been made tax-free. The Kerala Story, The Kashmir Files and The Bengal Files, all of these will be or have been made tax-free, and the same will apply to 'Ramayana'. In the days to come, we will see films on Shri Krishna and Arjuna, as well as the Mahabharata,” the West Bengal CM told ANI.

The announcement could make Ramayana: Part 1 more accessible to audiences across West Bengal, potentially supporting its theatrical prospects in a key market. The exemption is expected to draw attention to the film’s release in Kolkata and other parts of the state, although the precise implementation and impact on ticket prices will depend on the applicable tax arrangements.

Conceived as the first instalment of a planned two-part cinematic saga, Ramayana: Part 1 is a Hindi-language mythological film based on the ancient Sanskrit epic attributed to Valmiki. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who has co-written the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan, the film will bring the story of Prince Rama of Ayodhya, his exile and the trials surrounding his journey to the big screen on an ambitious scale.

The film features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, with Sai Pallavi portraying Sita. Kannada superstar Yash, widely known for his work in the K.G.F franchise, takes on the role of Ravana. Ravi Dubey will portray Lakshmana, adding another prominent name to the film’s ensemble.

The supporting cast includes Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman and Anupam Kher as Maharishi Vashistha. The film also features Kajal Aggarwal as Mandodari, Rakul Preet Singh as Surpanakha, Vivek Oberoi as Meghnada, also known as Indrajit, and Kunal Kapoor as Lord Indra.

Further additions to the ensemble include Adinath Kothare as Bharata, Lara Dutta as Kaikeyi and Indira Krishnan as Kausalya. Veteran actor Arun Govil, who became synonymous with Lord Rama after portraying the character in Ramanand Sagar’s iconic 1987 television series, will play King Dasharatha in the upcoming film. His casting adds a nostalgic dimension to a project revisiting one of Indian mythology’s most enduring stories.

Ramayana: Part 1 is being mounted on an ambitious scale by producer Namit Malhotra, associated with visual effects company DNEG, and Yash. The production aims to bring the epic’s characters, settings and pivotal events to life through large-scale visual effects and an expansive cinematic treatment.

The film’s music is being composed by A. R. Rahman and renowned German composer Hans Zimmer, bringing together two internationally recognised composers for the project.

With the West Bengal Chief Minister confirming the tax-free status of Ramayana, the film has gained an additional talking point ahead of its theatrical arrival.

title: Police Company release date: Ram Gopal Varma’s crime saga starring Harshvardhan Rane to hit theatres on June 4, 2027
raw_summary:
Filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma is returning to the Mumbai underworld with Police Company, an upcoming crime saga that will explore the city’s turbulent gang wars from the perspective of law enforcement. T-Series, in association with RGV Company Production, has officially announced the theatrical release date of the action thriller. Starring Harshvardhan Rane in the lead role, the film is scheduled to arrive in cinemas nationwide on June 4, 2027.

Known for exploring the underbelly of Mumbai through films like Satya and Company, Ram Gopal Varma is revisiting familiar territory with a narrative that shifts the focus from gangsters to the police officers who confronted them. In Police Company, Harshvardhan Rane will portray Daya Nayak, the Mumbai police encounter specialist whose operations became a significant part of the city’s underworld history.

Inspired by true events and real-life police officers who operated during the late 1990s and early 2000s, the film will delve into the functioning of Mumbai’s encounter squad during a particularly volatile period. The narrative is expected to explore the circumstances, aggressive policing tactics and high-stakes operations that shaped the battle against organised crime in the financial capital.

The film will revisit an era when gang-related violence and the underworld’s influence formed a significant part of Mumbai’s crime landscape. According to the film’s announcement, the story will trace the operations through which the encounter squad neutralised around 300 gangsters, eventually dismantling the underworld’s terror network in the city. By placing law enforcement at the centre of the narrative, Police Company aims to offer a different perspective on a chapter that has frequently inspired crime dramas in Hindi cinema.

Alongside Harshvardhan Rane, Police Company features Fardeen Khan, Fatima Sana Shaikh, Paresh Rawal, Saurabh Shukla, Makarand Deshpande and Ashwini Kalsekar in pivotal roles. The ensemble brings together several established performers, including actors who have previously been associated with Ram Gopal Varma’s distinctive brand of crime cinema.

The casting also marks a creative reunion for several veteran actors whose work has contributed to Varma’s crime-film legacy over the decades. Their presence adds to the film’s focus on an intense, character-driven narrative set against the backdrop of Mumbai’s underworld and the police operations mounted against it.

Presented by Gulshan Kumar and T-Series, Police Company is directed by Ram Gopal Varma and produced by Bhushan Kumar, Krishan Kumar and Ram Gopal Varma. The film is being made under the banners of T-Series Films and RGV Company Production.

With its real-life inspiration, portrayal of a defining period in Mumbai’s underworld history and Harshvardhan Rane stepping into the role of Daya Nayak, Police Company marks Varma’s return to a genre closely associated with his filmography. title: Arshad Warsi to return to Jolly LLB franchise for fourth part, film to wrap by January 2027: Report

With the fourth film reportedly going back in time, the story could explore an earlier chapter in Warsi’s character’s journey. However, details about the plot and the rest of the cast have not yet been officially announced. Will familiar faces return? Saurabh Shukla, whose portrayal of Judge Sunder Lal Tripathi has been a recurring part of the franchise, remains among the familiar faces audiences may hope to see again. Whether any of these actors, apart from Warsi, will return for the prequel remains unclear. The makers are yet to announce further casting details.
